title: Impossible Video Game Animations? NVIDIA GENMO AI Just Made It Real!
author: krishna2400

comments.author: owenwp
comments.body: Obviously super powerful, but doesn't look ready to use yet even if it were open source. Like in about half the examples where they transition from video to text input, the character staggers and turns 90 degrees for no apparent reason. Also seems like the only way to drive it in 3D space is to give it a full body pose target, which is too constrained for things like locomotion.
